decisions.decision: Feedback pages are emitted as standalone .html under docs/f/, never as .md.
decisions.rationale: MkDocs copies non-Markdown files verbatim, which keeps them out of the search index, the sitemap and the navigation. Emitting .md would place every student's full text into search_index.json, where a name typed into the course search box would surface it.

decisions.decision: URLs follow <slug-del-nombre>-<12 digitos aleatorios>.html; the codes live in exams/final-01/.enlaces.json so rebuilds keep the same links.
decisions.rationale: The instructor wanted the student name visible in the URL while making one student's link underivable from another's. --rotar issues new codes if a link must be invalidated.

decisions.decision: Protection is obscurity, accepted knowingly by the instructor.
decisions.rationale: Instructor's explicit call: for a five-student class, one student seeing another's feedback is a minor harm. Search-engine indexing was still blocked (noindex meta plus docs/robots.txt) because permanent public indexing of names and grades is a different order of risk.

decisions.decision: Grades were calibrated across all five exams after independent grading, and the calibration notes were then removed from the student-facing copies.
decisions.rationale: Parallel independent graders drifted, mostly on the justification axis; six adjustments of 0.1-0.4 harmonised them. The notes explaining that moderation are internal mechanics and stay in RESUMEN-NOTAS.md.

decisions.decision: Student submissions, feedback.md and RESUMEN-NOTAS.md stay gitignored; only the rendered HTML pages are published.
decisions.rationale: The repository is public. The rendered pages are the deliberate publication; the working files are not.

blocking_constraints.name: Public repository
blocking_constraints.description: Anything committed here is world-readable, including git history. Student PII must reach the repo only as the deliberately published docs/f/ pages.
blocking_constraints.prevention: Keep exams/final-01/ gitignored; check git status before committing after touching grading material.

blocking_constraints.name: MkDocs publishes its own index
blocking_constraints.description: search_index.json, sitemap.xml and the public gh-pages branch each enumerate site content, so an obscure URL alone does not make a Markdown page private.
blocking_constraints.prevention: Keep unlisted pages as .html, and after any publication verify zero /f/ entries in both sitemap.xml and search_index.json on the live site.

next_action: Send the five feedback URLs to the students. Everything technical is done and verified live; the remaining grading work is purely distribution.
